create_TextEncodingStage: create a TextEncodingStage instance with text encoders and tokenizers for diffusion pipelines
encode_text_prompts: encode text prompts into embeddings using selected text encoders with configurable return types
verify_input_batch: verify input batch fields including prompt, negative prompt, and classifier-free guidance flags
verify_output_embeds: verify output embeddings are non-empty lists of tensors with at least two dimensions
run_forward_encoding: run the forward pass to encode positive and negative prompts into hidden state embeddings
